title: esp32bench circuit
description: Virtual parts placed on one project's board for the simulator. Version 1.x. Saved by the desktop app per project and board; designed so the project manifest can carry the same data later. Pins are GPIO numbers. Firmware-level: an LED is lit when its pin drives it; no electrical behaviour is modelled.

kind.description: led: lit while its pin is an output at its active level. button: drives its pin to its active level while pressed, and to the other level otherwise (a pull-up or pull-down).

activeLow.description: Active when the pin is low: an LED wired to 3V3, or a button to GND with a pull-up (INPUT_PULLUP).
